consequence.statement: Any configuration using the 1.20 compatibilityProfile or its associated removed feature flags (ENABLE_EXTERNAL_NAME_ALIAS, PERSIST_OLDEST_FIRST_HEURISTIC_FOR_VIRTUAL_SERVICE_HOST_MATCHING, VERIFY_CERTIFICATE_AT_CLIENT) will be ignored or cause failures after upgrade.
consequence.remediation: Remove any references to the 1.20 compatibilityProfile and update configurations using the removed feature flags. ENABLE_AUTO_SNI remains available as an alternative.

original.statement: Support for the 1.20 compatibilityProfile has been removed, along with the feature flags it configured (ENABLE_EXTERNAL_NAME_ALIAS, PERSIST_OLDEST_FIRST_HEURISTIC_FOR_VIRTUAL_SERVICE_HOST_MATCHING, VERIFY_CERTIFICATE_AT_CLIENT), while ENABLE_AUTO_SNI remains available.

consequence.statement: After the upgrade, selecting the 1.20 compatibilityProfile no longer applies the 1.20 settings, because support was removed. Values set for ENABLE_EXTERNAL_NAME_ALIAS, PERSIST_OLDEST_FIRST_HEURISTIC_FOR_VIRTUAL_SERVICE_HOST_MATCHING and VERIFY_CERTIFICATE_AT_CLIENT are no longer honoured, because these flags were removed from Istio entirely. ENABLE_AUTO_SNI was not removed.
consequence.remediation: Remove references to the 1.20 compatibilityProfile and to the removed flags. Check that the mesh works correctly without the 1.20-era behaviour these settings provided. ENABLE_AUTO_SNI is still available as its own flag.

corrected.statement: Istio 1.24.0 removed the 1.20 compatibilityProfile. It also removed the flags ENABLE_EXTERNAL_NAME_ALIAS, PERSIST_OLDEST_FIRST_HEURISTIC_FOR_VIRTUAL_SERVICE_HOST_MATCHING and VERIFY_CERTIFICATE_AT_CLIENT, so selecting that profile or setting those flags is no longer honoured.

decision.reason: [ev-e54c7ef2acc9] says support for the 1.20 compatibilityProfile was removed and that ENABLE_EXTERNAL_NAME_ALIAS, PERSIST_OLDEST_FIRST_HEURISTIC_FOR_VIRTUAL_SERVICE_HOST_MATCHING and VERIFY_CERTIFICATE_AT_CLIENT were removed from Istio entirely. That supports setting-ignored: the profile and those flags stop being honoured. The evidence does not say anything "causes failures", so the proposed statement claims too much. ENABLE_AUTO_SNI is only the one flag that was not removed, not a replacement, so the remediation misreads the text and the severity should be lowered.
